q: Formula for calculation of demurrage charges is

options.A: (Time of release – Time of placement) - Free Time
options.B: (Time of placement – Time of release) - Free Time
options.C: Time of release – Time of placement

e: The correct answer is (Time of release – Time of placement) - Free Time. Demurrage is computed as (Time of release minus Time of placement) minus Free Time. The detention period runs from placement of the rake to its release, and the admissible free time is deducted from this total; demurrage is charged only on the net excess hours.
